name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: CHANGES REQUIRED: the task commands the agent to open the door when picking up the key, but the machine does not require the door to be open when the key is picked up. The task is: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door. The machine has a hard RespondedExistence clause that only requires the door to be open after the key is picked up, not when it is picked up. Add a hard Precedence clause to require the door to be open before the key is picked up.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to pick up the target box, but the only RespondedExistence is between has_door_key and door_open. The agent is required to pick up the target box, not just open the door. Add a hard Existence for the target_picked_up event and a Precedence for the door_open and target_picked_up events. Remove the RespondedExistence clause and keep the rest of the machine the same.

CHANGES REQUIRED: the task requires the agent to pick up the target box, but no clause makes it happen. Add a hard Existence(target_picked_up); keep the RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) hard. The machine has no FINAL_STATES because it has no hard goal, but adding Existence(target_picked_up) as hard will fix it.

texts: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
